summary: SciSparc Ltd. (Nasdaq: SPRC), an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a strategic shift toward Agentic AI-powered technologies, including cybersecurity and finance. The October 15, 2026 press release follows a July 27, 2026 decision to target Agentic AI and an August 26, 2026 Scientific Advisory Board formation. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or timeline is stated. Management will evaluate technologies, companies, and opportunities; no assurance any transaction or revenue results. Watch for deal announcements, financing given the F-3 shelf, and Nasdaq compliance risk.
